membershipMethod.required: All9 configured core destinations remain separately required; these expectations do not weaken their existing required-name gate.
membershipMethod.editorial: Every pre-existing authored trailhead/camp destination remains represented, including edge cases. Historical authored selection supplies relevance independently of current solver visibility.
membershipMethod.additionalSample: Four remaining source trailhead/camp destinations chosen by maximum distance from the already selected destinations, repeatedly with annotationID tie-break; no visibility input.
membershipMethod.equivalence: Normalized type-suffix aliases must share destination purpose and lie within250m or an area (including a closed mapped campground outline) must contain the authored anchor. Two explicitly reviewed authored trailhead-name aliases require75m. This is review-fixture matching, not a production merge, geographic correction, or proof of exact ground position.
membershipMethod.nonEquivalence: Nearby different-purpose/different-name places remain distinct: Cape Final campsite/trailhead; North Kaibab/Ken Patrick; Havasupai Gardens/Plateau Point Trailhead; Phantom Ranch/ranger station/lodge building.
membershipMethod.denominatorRationale: Raw annotation denominators double-count editorial/node/area representations of one destination and can penalize correct repeat suppression. This reviewed representative destination baseline counts any verified equivalent label once; it does not assert that every catalog primary destination is visible. Preserve the separate raw-primary diagnostic.
